rationale: Fixed J2000 KP cluster density: Ascendant 48.00% across H1/H3/H6/H10/H11; Descendant 36.00% across H7/H9/H12/H4/H5.
Descendant minus Ascendant density = -12.00%; the fixed ±2.00% threshold resolves ascendant.

Each cusp uses its fixed Nakshatra Sub-Lord; significations combine fixed-sector occupancy, traditional fixed-sign rulership, seventh aspect, and node fifth/seventh/ninth aspects. Density is retained as raw evidence and divided by 10 only for equal-peer synthesis with Territorial Control.
KP Stellar leads the synthesis at 60%; Territorial Control contributes the remaining 40% as an independent challenger layer.
The layers diverge; inspect the house-by-house KP chain before treating the call as high-conviction.

synthesis.formula: Current seven-layer Territorial foundation + each recovered archive addition + current full KP win-fit; all coefficients are fixed at 1.0 and were not tuned to outcomes.

rationale: Fixed J2000 KP cluster density: Ascendant 48.00% across H1/H3/H6/H10/H11; Descendant 36.00% across H7/H9/H12/H4/H5.
Descendant minus Ascendant density = -12.00%; the fixed ±2.00% threshold resolves ascendant.

Each cusp uses its fixed Nakshatra Sub-Lord; significations combine fixed-sector occupancy, traditional fixed-sign rulership, seventh aspect, and node fifth/seventh/ninth aspects. Density is retained as raw evidence and divided by 10 only for equal-peer synthesis with Territorial Control.
KP Stellar leads the synthesis at 60%; Territorial Control contributes the remaining 40% as an independent challenger layer.
The layers diverge; inspect the house-by-house KP chain before treating the call as high-conviction.

rationale: Fixed J2000 KP cluster density: Ascendant 48.00% across H1/H3/H6/H10/H11; Descendant 36.00% across H7/H9/H12/H4/H5.
Descendant minus Ascendant density = -12.00%; the fixed ±2.00% threshold resolves ascendant.

Each cusp uses its fixed Nakshatra Sub-Lord; significations combine fixed-sector occupancy, traditional fixed-sign rulership, seventh aspect, and node fifth/seventh/ninth aspects. Density is retained as raw evidence and divided by 10 only for equal-peer synthesis with Territorial Control.
KP Stellar leads the synthesis at 60%; Territorial Control contributes the remaining 40% as an independent challenger layer.
The layers diverge; inspect the house-by-house KP chain before treating the call as high-conviction.

synthesis.formula: Current seven-layer Territorial foundation + each recovered archive addition + current full KP win-fit; all coefficients are fixed at 1.0 and were not tuned to outcomes.

rationale: Fixed J2000 KP cluster density: Ascendant 48.00% across H1/H3/H6/H10/H11; Descendant 36.00% across H7/H9/H12/H4/H5.
Descendant minus Ascendant density = -12.00%; the fixed ±2.00% threshold resolves ascendant.

Each cusp uses its fixed Nakshatra Sub-Lord; significations combine fixed-sector occupancy, traditional fixed-sign rulership, seventh aspect, and node fifth/seventh/ninth aspects. Density is retained as raw evidence and divided by 10 only for equal-peer synthesis with Territorial Control.
KP Stellar leads the synthesis at 60%; Territorial Control contributes the remaining 40% as an independent challenger layer.
The layers diverge; inspect the house-by-house KP chain before treating the call as high-conviction.

synthesis.formula: Current seven-layer Territorial foundation + each recovered archive addition + current full KP win-fit; all coefficients are fixed at 1.0 and were not tuned to outcomes.
